predictions.prediction_text: Strong sticky gamma cluster centered around ~5875 acting as a pin/magnet; concentrated gamma trough (red) indicates price likely to gravitate toward and be pinned near 5875 during the session.
predictions.condition: price remains within intraday range and vol does not spike (no short-squeeze)
predictions.expected_result: SPX will move toward and spend significant time near 5875; expect reversion back to ~5875 within same trading day if price wanders +/- ~15-25 points.
